description:
From the fz-kdt.106 cold review + refutation (2026-09-01). Vec<Ty>::equivalent
is pointwise Types::is_equivalent = mutual is_subtype, and is_subtype
decides closure-arrow emptiness from fn_id + captures alone
(emptiness.rs::func_clause_empty ~:191-219 -- args/ret never read), so a
template arrow and a ground arrow over ONE lambda are judged equivalent.

TWO measured consequences in ActivationInputAlternatives::insert_row:

(1) AT BASE (pre-existing): a template row and a ground row whose other
columns match collapse into each other, and which one survives is
whichever ARRIVED FIRST -- a schedule-confluence hole in the antichain.
Measured (review harness, equiv_not_dom counter): 8 fixtures exhibit
pairs equivalence accepts that the dominance relation rejects -- 52 on
00277, 46 on behavior/enum_map_family, 30 on range_map, 16 on 00420, 8
on 00276, 6 each on list_literal_trailing_call and map_enumerable.

(2) AT HEAD (fz-kdt.106 ENLARGES the consequence -- refuter-measured):
because the equivalence skip returns early BEFORE dominance runs, an
incoming row equivalent to a standing row never absorbs the standing
rows it dominates, so arrival order now decides HOW MANY rows survive,
not just which twin: with A=[:a|:b, template], C=[:a|:b, ground] (A~C),
B=[:a, ground] (dominated by C, not A): head order A,B,C -> 2 rows,
order C,B,A -> 1 row (base: 2 rows both orders). Row count feeds
ACTIVATION_INPUT_ROW_BUDGET and specialization width. Corpus symptom
today: none (all gated lenses FIFO==LIFO byte-identical; 577-fixture
stdout sweep clean) -- the ingredient is present, the trigger is not.
Reordering the two checks does NOT fix it (cases worked in the
refutation); only the fold does.

DECIDE: either the equivalence skip adopts the same
free-var-set/literal-shape discipline as Types::row_column_dominates and
the two fold into ONE relation (preferred -- fold-concordant), or
insert_row documents why two contradictory judgements about one pair
coexist and which is authoritative. insert_row's doc (post-106) states
the enlargement and points here; this ticket owns the fold decision and
its artifact re-measurement.
title: insert_row's whole-row equivalence skip is closure-literal-blind: arrival order decides which of a template/ground pair survives at base
